arabic text: YA HUSSAIN..\nO HUSSAIN..
SHAAM KA BAZAAR KUJA, ABID E BEEMAR KUJA..
english translation text: WHERE IS THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM, AND WHERE IS THE AILING ABID (IMAM SAJJAD)?..

arabic text: ZAINAB E DILGEER KUJA, MAJMA E AGHYAAR KUJA
english translation text: WHERE IS THE GRIEF-STRICKEN ZAINAB, AND WHERE IS THE CROWD OF STRANGERS?

arabic text: HAYE SHAAM, HAYE SHAAM, HAYE SHAAM..
english translation text: ALAS, SHAAM... ALAS, SHAAM... ALAS, SHAAM..

arabic text: TERI UMMAT KE ZEWAR PEHENKAR.
english translation text: WEARING THE ADORNMENTS OF YOUR UMMAH..

arabic text: MERE NANA CHALI HU MAI SHAAM
english translation text: O MY GRANDFATHER (THE PROPHET), I AM BEING TAKEN TO SHAAM

arabic text: SHAAM HAYE SHAAM.
english translation text: SHAAM, ALAS SHAAM.

arabic text: MAI DETI KAFAN TUJHKO BHAYYA GAR SAR PE RIDA MERE HOTI
english translation text: BROTHER, I WOULD HAVE GIVEN YOU A SHROUD IF ONLY I HAD A VEIL ON MY HEAD

arabic text: GAR HOTE KHULE HAATH MERE TERE ZAKHMO KO HATHON SE DHOTI
english translation text: IF MY HANDS WERE FREE, I WOULD HAVE WIPED YOUR WOUNDS WITH MY OWN HANDS

arabic text: PA BANDE RASAN SAR BAREHNA..
english translation text: BUT MY FEET ARE SHACKLED AND MY HEAD IS BARE..

arabic text: DEKHO BHAYYA CHALI HU MAI SHAAM
english translation text: LOOK, MY BROTHER, I AM NOW HEADED TO SHAAM

arabic text: JIS ZAINAB KO TUMNE BARADAR KABHI NAKHRE UTHA KAR NA DEKHA
english translation text: THE ZAINAB WHOM YOU, BROTHER, NEVER EVEN SAW LIFTING BURDENS OR FUSSING

arabic text: HAATH RASSI SE MERE BANDHE HAI AUR SAR PAR NAHI MERE PARDA
english translation text: TODAY, MY HANDS ARE TIED WITH ROPE, AND MY HEAD IS WITHOUT A VEIL

arabic text: KAISE KUFE MEIN JAUNGI GHAAZI..
english translation text: HOW WILL I EVER TRAVEL TO KUFA, O GHAAZI (ABBAS).

arabic text: JAB BALWE MEIN AAYEGA NAAM
english translation text: WHEN MY NAME IS CALLED AMIDST THIS RIOT

arabic text: JAISE DARBAAR PAAS AA RAHA HAI MERA DIL DOOBTA JAA RAHA HAI
english translation text: AS WE APPROACH THE COURT, MY HEART CONTINUES TO SINK

arabic text: MAI TO GHAR MEIN BHI KAM BOLTI THI BHAI TUMKO TO SAB KUCH PATA HAI
english translation text: BROTHER, YOU KNOW WELL, EVEN AT HOME I USED TO SPEAK SO LITTLE

arabic text: KIS TARHA SE KAREGI BATA DE..
english translation text: TELL ME, HOW WILL ZAINAB SPEAK..

arabic text: EK SHARABI SE ZAINAB KALAAM.
english translation text: TO A DRUNKARD, HOW WILL ZAINAB CONVERSE?

arabic text: DIL YE KEHTA HAI RO RO KE BHAYYA KAASH ABBAS MAUJOOD HOTA
english translation text: MY HEART WEEPS AND SAYS: IF ONLY ABBAS WAS HERE, BROTHER

arabic text: KAAT DETA WO USKI ZABAN KO KOI BAGHI AGAR MUJHKO KEHTA
english translation text: HE WOULD HAVE SEVERED THE TONGUE OF ANY REBEL WHO DARED CALL ME A TRAITOR

arabic text: DEKHTI PHIR MAI KIS TARHA LETA..
english translation text: THEN I WOULD SEE WHO WOULD DARE SPEAK MY NAME IN THIS CROWD..

arabic text: KOI ZAINAB KA MAJME MEIN NAAM
english translation text: WHO WOULD DARE UTTER ZAINAB’S NAME IN SUCH A CROWD

arabic text: KEH RAHE HAI YE HAS HAS KE SHAAMI AANE WALE HAI DARBAAR BAGH
english translation text: THESE PEOPLE OF SHAAM LAUGH AND SAY: THE REBELS ARE NOW COMING TO THE COURT

arabic text: JISNE AJDAAD MAARE HAMARE AA RAHI HAI YAHA USKI BETI
english translation text: HERE COMES THE DAUGHTER OF THE ONE WHO KILLED OUR FOREFATHERS

arabic text: KHOLTA PAANI PHEKO CHHATO SE..
english translation text: POUR BOILING WATER FROM THE ROOFTOPS.

arabic text: PATHARO KA KARO INTEZAAM
english translation text: PREPARE THE STONES TO HURL AT THEM

arabic text: HAYE SHAAM, HAYE SHAAM, HAYE SHAAM..
english translation text: ALAS SHAAM, ALAS SHAAM, ALAS SHAAM..

arabic text: ME DETI KAFAN TUJKO BHAIYYA, GAR SAR PE RIDAA MERE HOTI\nGAR HOTE KHULE HAATH MERE, TERE ZAKHMON KO HAATHON SE DHOTI, PAABANDE RASAN SAR BAREHNA\nDEKHO BHAIYYA CHALI HU ME SHAAM
english translation text: I WOULD HAVE GIVEN YOU A SHROUD, OH MY BROTHER,\nIF I HAD ADEQUATE HIJAB ON MY HEAD IF MY HANDS WERE NOT TIED,\nI WOULD HAVE WASHED YOUR WOUNDS WITH MY HANDS WITH MY HANDS CHAINED, AND WITHOUT MY VEIL, O MY BROTHER I AM GOING TO SHAAM

arabic text: JIS ZAYNAB KO TUMNE BARADAR, KABHI NAZRE UTTHA KAR NA DEKHA\nHAATH RASSI SE MERE BANDHE HAI, AUR SAR PAR NAHIN MERE PARDA, KAISE KUFE ME JAA-OONGI GHAZI
english translation text: ZAINAB, WHOM YOU ALWAYS TREATED WITH SO MUCH RESPECT, OH BROTHER, HER HANDS ARE TIED WITH ROPES, AND NO VEIL\nON HER HEAD HOW WILL I GO TO KUFA LIKE THIS? WHEN MY NAME WILL BE TAKEN IN PUBLIC

arabic text: JAISE DARBAAR PAAS AA RAHA HAI, MERA DIL DOOB TA JAA RAHA HAI, ME TO GHAR ME BHI KAM BOLTI THI, BHAI TUJKO TO SAB KUCH PATA HAI\nKIS TARHA SE KAREGI BATA DE, EK SHARAABI SE ZAYNAB KALAAM
english translation text: AS THE COURTYARD GETS CLOSER, MY HEART IS SINKING I NEVER TALKED MUCH AT HOME, YOU KNOW\nTHAT PLEASE TELL ME, HOW I WILL GET THROUGH THIS PAIN OF SPEAKING WITH A DRUNK MAN

arabic text:
DIL YE KEHTA HAI RO RO KE BHAIYYA, KAASH ABBAS MAWJOOD HOTAA
KAAT DETA WO USKI ZABAAN KO, KOI BAAGHI AGAR MUJKO KEHTA
DEKHTI PHIR ME KIS TARHA LETA
KOI ZAYNAB KA MAJME ME NAAM
english translation text:
MY HEART KEEPS CRYING, I WISH ABBAS WAS PRESENT
HERE HE WOULD HAVE CUT THEIR TONGUES, WHOEVER CALLS
ME A TRAITOR, THEN NO ONE WOULD HAVE
THE COURAGE TO CALL ZAINAB’S NAME IN THIS CROWD

arabic text:
KEH RAHE HAI YE HAS HAS KE SHAAMI, AANE WAALE HAI DARBAR BAAGHI
JISNE AJDAAD MAARE HAMARE, AA RAHI HAI YAHAAN USKI BETI
KHOLTA PAANI PHEKHON CHHATON SE
PATHARON KA KARO INTEZAAM
english translation text:
PEOPLE OF SHAAM ARE LAUGHING AND SAYING THE TRAITORS ARE
COMING TO COURT THE ONE WHO KILLED OUR FOREFATHERS, HIS
DAUGHTER WILL BE COMING HERE, THEY WILL THROW BOILING WATER
ON US FROM ROOFTOPS AND ARE PREPARING TO THROW STONES TOO
